facts.fact: Newport held the first U.S. Amateur and the first U.S. Open, October 1895.
Logo idea from the scouting brief (a hickory club and a gutty ball over waves).

concepts.name: Hickory and Gutty, 1895
concepts.rationale: A hickory-shafted, long-nosed wooden club and a hand-hammered gutta-percha ball over a run of Atlantic waves.
concepts.strengths: One subject, no background, in the house style (developer 2026-10-25: no circular badges).
